name: Visa de Inversionista Calificado

requirements.blocker_text: Requires unencumbered ('libre de gravámenes') Panamanian real estate worth at least USD 300,000, funded from abroad.
requirements.fix_path: Acquire and document qualifying, unencumbered property.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires at least USD 300,000 committed through a trust or direct payments to a developer under a purchase-promise contract, funded from abroad.
requirements.fix_path: Fund and document the qualifying purchase-promise contract.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires at least USD 500,000 invested in securities issued by Panamanian companies, funded from abroad.
requirements.fix_path: Fund and document the qualifying securities investment.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires at least USD 750,000 on fixed-term deposit at a general-license Panamanian bank, for a term of no less than 5 years, funded from abroad.
requirements.fix_path: Fund and document the qualifying fixed-term deposit.

evidence_required.document: Proof that all invested funds originated from abroad
Category-specific investment documentation (deed, trust contract, brokerage statement, or CD certificate)

outcome.duration_length: indefinite -- immediate permanent residence, no provisional period, conditioned on maintaining the investment for at least 5 years

sources.title: IPAL (Panamanian legal/consulting firm) -- Visa Inversionista Calificado: four investment categories (real estate, purchase-promise, securities, fixed deposit), immediate permanent residence, 5-year naturalisation eligibility

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Panama's initial build. STATUS SET TO DRAFT: migracion.gob.pa's own overview page (tier-1) confirms a 'Qualified Investor' category exists among Panama's permanent-resident special-policy grounds (grouped there with forest investment and macro-enterprise investment), but the specific dollar thresholds and category breakdown were only found and confirmed via a tier-3 Panamanian legal/consulting firm, since a matching migracion.gob.pa requirements PDF was not located and fetched in this pass. FOUR GENUINELY DIFFERENT INVESTMENT GROUNDS modelled as OR-logic groups. This is Panama's most 'golden visa'-like route: immediate permanent residence with no provisional stage, unlike most other Panamanian economic routes. Two related categories mentioned on migracion.gob.pa's overview but not independently researched or modelled here: the Forest/Reforestation Investor visa and the Macro-Empresa (macro-enterprise) investor visa -- flagged as gaps for a future revisit rather than folded into this file without their own sourcing.
